info.album: The Dream Of The Blue Turtles

podcast.body: The second single from "The Dream of the Blue Turtles," this airy track reached number eight on the Hot 100. Critics later categorized its style as "Sophistopop," drawing comparisons to artists like Roxy Music, The Style Council, or Sade. "A number eight hit that leaned toward what critics would later call Sephistopop, akin to the Roxy Music, the Style Council, or Shade."

podcast.body: This song was the second single from Sting's first solo album, "The Dream of the Blue Turtles," and reached the top 10 on Billboard's Hot 100 in October 1985. It was characterized as an "achingly romantic, strenuously poetic ballad," showcasing Sting's sophisticated, verbose, sexy, and angular style. "Cracked the top 10 on Billboard's Hot 100 with the second single from his first solo album, an achingly romantic, strenuously poetic ballad called Fortress Around Your Heart."
